Wind Tunnel Garage

Design your own racing car, then test it in a virtual wind tunnel.

Step 1 of 2Design and paint

Your job is to make a car that looks brilliant and slips through the air. You can change colours and shape. Nothing you do here can break the car.

  1. Paint it. Tap a part of the car, or pick a panel from the list. Then choose a colour.
  2. Reshape it. Open the Shape tab and move the sliders to change the body.
  3. Test it. Happy with your car? Press the green Finish and test button.
Step 2 of 2Wind tunnel

Air is blowing past your car from the left. Each stream shows what the air is doing. Turn the car by dragging it.

  • Clear air: misses the car
  • Brushes the car
  • Hits the car and slows down

Before you start

How it works

1

Design

Pick a car, paint every panel and reshape its body.

2

Test

Press Finish and test. Watch the air stream past your car in the wind tunnel.

3

Improve

Read your drag, downforce and top speed. Go back, tweak your design and beat your score.

What you will learn

Drag
Air pushing back on the car. Like putting your hand out of a car window.
Downforce
Air pushing the car down. A wing works like an upside-down aeroplane wing.
Top speed
The fastest the car can go with the same engine. A slippery shape goes faster.
Balance
Front and rear grip need to match, or the car will slide.
